description: Revert journaled coder writes in this workspace: the last N records ({ steps }, default 1) or everything a specific turn changed ({ turn_id } — coder::checkpoints lists them). Restores run newest first through the live jail; files that did not exist before a write are removed, others are rewritten to their before-image. The undo journals its own pre-undo state first, so running coder::undo again REDOES the change. Unrecoverable gaps (oversized before-images, directory deletes/moves) are reported in `skipped`, never silently ignored.

steps.description: Undo the last N journaled records (default 1). Mutually exclusive with `turn_id`.

turn_id.description: Undo every journaled record this turn produced (see `coder::checkpoints` for turn ids). Mutually exclusive with `steps`.

removed.description: Files removed (they did not exist before the journaled write).

restored.description: Files rewritten to their journaled before-image.

skipped.description: Unrecoverable gaps: oversized before-images, directory operations, or paths the live jail rejected — inspect these manually.

undone.description: Undone records, newest first. The undo itself was journaled before any restore, so `coder::undo { steps: 1 }` again redoes the change.
